hints.title: Right-to-Left Car Processing
hints.text: Process cars from right to left; the rightmost car never collides with anything in front.

hints.title: Maintain Candidate Fleets
hints.text: Maintain an ordered collection of leading cars in front of the current car.

hints.title: Prune Slower and Merged Cars
hints.text: Pop cars from candidate collection that travel faster than or equal to current car, or that merge with ahead fleets before current car catches them.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating collision events sequentially using event queues takes O(n^2) in worst case cascades.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Monotonic stack processes each car at most once for insertion and deletion in amortized O(n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles transitively merged fleets by comparing collision time with ans[top].
